data.define: Used when you feel totally exhausted.

misuse.text: Don't say 'wiped out' about cleaning a table.

publish.title: What does "wiped out" mean?
publish.value: Wiped out = Completely out of energy. Example: "I'm wiped out, so no movie tonight." (casual English, US).
